name: King Naresuan
lore: The warrior king who freed Siam from Burmese domination. Famous for his elephant duel against the Burmese crown prince, Naresuan is the symbol of Thai independence and martial valor.

abilities.name: Elephant Charge
abilities.description: Naresuan's attacks knock back infantry units 50 tiles. Armored units are slowed 30% instead.

abilities.name: Royal Challenge
abilities.description: Challenges the nearest enemy hero to single combat. Both heroes are locked in place for 8 seconds, dealing 2x damage to each other. Naresuan wins if he has more HP remaining.

abilities.name: Siamese Liberation
abilities.description: Naresuan charges through all enemies in a straight line, dealing 200 damage to each and reducing their armor by 40% for 15 seconds.
